title: Tech Saturn Feb.1997: E, Chocolate? Kurereba Morau yo
native_title: ＴＥＣＨ ＳＡＴＵＲＮ ＦＥＢ．１９９７ 「え、チョコレート？くれればもらうよ」
overview: Tech Saturn Feb. 1997 is the Sega Saturn CD-ROM that came packed in a sleeve inside the February 1997 issue of Tech Saturn, ASCII's Saturn magazine. Each issue's disc mixed trial versions of Saturn games with original content made by the magazine's own staff.
